name: pi-native-paced-two-session-bounded-retry-v1
caller: Unchanged accepted pi_durable_service_v2 adapter, two independent Harness (native Session subclasses) and SQLite databases in the same worker process.
question: For matched finite 10 ms spaced arrivals into two independent two-slot Sessions, how do immediate refusal and an explicit bounded retry caller differ in accepted useful work and cost, while authority, identity, pre/post-effect cancellation and two process reopens remain correct?

workload.load_schedule: Alternate2native Sessions; fixed0..110ms per stage, retain offered lateness; never await task completion before offering. Load targets authorized conversation0. Blocking native admit time may delay actual offering; record, do not call exact open-loop generator.
workload.controls: Eachstage starts2accepted gate-held controls perSession to force overload. Stage0:one currentauthoritydenial and one heldposteffect survivor perSession. Stage1:one preeffect abort/one posteffectabort retaining its committed effect, then one new post-effect survivor perSession. Stage2:two ordinary commits perSession.6duplicate/conflict/stale probesperstage total.
workload.recovery: Controller kills worker after stage0/1 logs and queue drained, one survivor/Session atfinish; reopens both databases in new process, replays finish once, no effect duplication.

queue.overflow: refuse promptly as backpressured without retaining request
queue.persistence: Caller queue volatile and drained before injected crash; no pending-queue crash durability claim
queue.deadline_scope: Age is checked before starting a retry admission, not an async completion/cancellation deadline. Native admit may block past this age; histories and finished records grow.
queue.ownership: One owner awaits offer/tick serially; no concurrent multi-producer guarantee.

acceptance.correctness: All 50 offered identities accounted: each of 36 load identities has one final caller disposition; accepted load and all 14 controls have distinct per-Session native terminal records. Authorized accepted effects have count 1 and exact payload; deny/pre-effect abort have zero, post-effect abort retains count 1. Two databases independently reconcile full task/document endpoints and two conversations each; observed active <= 2 each; four recovered finish tasks per arm; pending <= 4; attempts <= 8; retry admission starts >= 20 ms apart and before 200 ms age, not a completion deadline. Report null latency for no accepted load. No positive throughput or acceptance-ratio threshold.

engineering.actual_caller: Time-paced caller around the accepted native Session adapter, with two independent SQLite-backed Harness instances.
engineering.scale_bottleneck: Finite per-Session active capacity overload and caller pending growth, permission changes and repeated task effects after process reopen.
engineering.native_integration: BoundedRetryQueue calls the unchanged adapter admit; cancellation and recovery use actual Harness task records and persisted same-database effects.
engineering.pre_registered_acceptance: Exact correctness and resource limits above; fixed finite offered cohort, descriptive cost comparison.
engineering.validated_tier_if_passed: Single Windows host, native two-Session custom-task integration; synthetic gates, trusted-host authority, local transactional effects, no models or provider service.
